tapeLine: Tuesday 17 November: S&P 500 −1.03% to 7,340.53, its fourth straight loss and lowest close since late July; Dow −848.75 (−1.64%) to 50,759.42; Nasdaq Composite −181.37 (−0.74%) to 24,328.38 (AP via Washington Post; CNBC; Motley Fool, 17 Nov).
matters:
Stocks fell for a fourth session Tuesday, with all 11 S&P sectors lower and the Dow down more than 1,000 points at its low; coverage cited chip and AI pressure and a CNN report of an outage on the NSA’s classified network (Motley Fool, StockTitan, 17 Nov). October retail sales rose 0.2%, in line with estimates, after a revised 0.8% in September; ex-gas stations about +0.1% (RTTNews, Boston 25/AP, 17 Nov). The 10-year eased about 2 bp to roughly 5.10% (Cappnotes, CNBC, 17 Nov).

After the close Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion (+103% y/y), data-center revenue of $107.6 billion, and guided Q4 to $130.0 billion ±3%, assuming no China data-center compute revenue (Nvidia release, 17 Nov). Shares rose after hours, and index futures were higher early Wednesday, led by the Nasdaq-100 (FXStreet, Yahoo Finance, 18 Nov). Today: October housing starts at 8:30 ET, FOMC minutes at 2:00 ET, and Anthropic’s IPO is expected to price this evening with trading Thursday.

alsoOnTape: 10-year Treasury yield about 5.10% at Tuesday’s close, down about 2 bp; 2-year near 4.80%; 30-year about 5.46% (Cappnotes, The Weekend Spread, CNBC, 17 Nov). An oil settlement, gold, the dollar index and VIX were not found with a clean dated closing source and are left out.
overnight: Latest confirmed close — Tuesday 17 November: S&P 500 7,340.53 (−1.03%); Nasdaq Composite 24,328.38 (−0.74%); Dow 50,759.42 (−848.75, −1.64%). Trading Economics shows a different Dow figure (50,651); the CNBC/Yahoo figure is carried.

Nvidia — closed Tuesday at $155.46 (−0.44%) before reporting. Revenue $115.84B against a ~$109.1B estimate; adjusted EPS $2.68 against ~$2.48; Q4 guide $130.0B ±3% against $125.1B LSEG consensus; Q4 gross margin guided to 71–72% from 74.8% GAAP in Q3 (Nvidia release; StockTitan; TradingKey, 17 Nov). After-hours gain was reported variously between about 2% and 4%; no single figure is carried.

Futures — early Wednesday 18 Nov: Nasdaq-100 futures up roughly 0.9%–1.4% and S&P 500 futures up roughly 0.4%–0.8% depending on timestamp, Dow futures up about 0.1%–0.3% (FXStreet, Yahoo Finance, Stocktwits, 18 Nov).
macro: Retail sales, October — +0.2% m/m, matching estimates, after a revised +0.8% in September. Gas stations +1.5%, motor vehicle dealers −1.6%, furniture −2.3%, clothing −0.7%, online +1.2% (RTTNews; Boston 25/AP, 17 Nov). The ex-autos figure was not found with a clean source.
FOMC minutes — due 2:00 ET for the October meeting, at which the Fed held at 3.75%–4.00% in a 10–2 vote (BigGo Finance, Xoomar previews, 18 Nov).

Anthropic IPO — 825 million shares marketed at $70–$78; pricing expected Wednesday evening, trading Thursday. The company reportedly told investors it expects to price at the top of the range or above; that is a report, not a final price (Yahoo Finance, Investing.com, 18 Nov). Valuation figures in coverage vary and are not carried.
flow: Breadth, dealer gamma, put-call and skew are paid data and are not on this page.

regime.tag: Four straight S&P 500 losses to a late-July low, with the 10-year still above 5%, into a Nvidia beat-and-raise overnight.
regime.sizing: Whether Nvidia’s overnight futures lift holds through today’s FOMC minutes and the Anthropic pricing is unresolved.

secondOrder: For a second straight session stocks fell while the 10-year yield eased about 2 bp, consistent with Monday’s observation that the selling was AI-specific rather than rate-driven. Nvidia’s Q4 outlook excludes China data-center compute revenue entirely, so any China change is outside the guide. Observations, not forecasts.

scorecard.text: The prior brief carried a consensus of +0.2% m/m for October retail sales. The print was +0.2%, in line (RTTNews, 17 Nov).

The prior brief reported index futures lower early Tuesday (about −0.34%). Direction held, but the snapshot again understated the day: the S&P 500 closed −1.03% and the Dow −1.64% (AP via Washington Post, 17 Nov).

The prior brief listed Nvidia fiscal Q3 results after Tuesday’s close, the first since Jensen Huang’s resignation. They were released as scheduled (Nvidia release, 17 Nov). The carried consensus (EPS $2.47, revenue $108.85B) was beaten: $2.68 and $115.84B.

The prior brief said whether retail sales and Nvidia would change the pattern of stocks falling with yields easing was unresolved. Tuesday repeated the pattern; Nvidia’s effect is not yet visible in a cash close. No direction was called.
The prior brief said Anthropic’s IPO is reported to price 18 Nov with trading 19 Nov. Coverage still points to that timing; it has not priced yet.
